hook.name: RobinhoodV4SingleVaultHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 launchpad hook that charges a fixed 1.5% fee on swaps denominated in the payment token (non-launch token), minting fees as ERC-6909 claims to a configured recipient per pool. Pool registration and pool initialization are permissioned to a factory address; liquidity additions are restricted to a designated position manager.
